# 🌊 Puducherry — 3‑Day Trip
> **Chennai → Puducherry** · 27 Nov 2026 – 29 Nov 2026 · 2 people · Budget ₹14,000 · Estimated total ₹10,880

## ✨ At a glance
- **Getting there:** Ordinary semi‑deluxe bus, 4 h 30 m, ₹350 pp
- **Stay:** **RMA Joliday Inn** – ₹1,200 /night, 3★, free Wi‑Fi & breakfast, book on Booking.com
- **Weather:** Pleasant – max 28 °C, min 22 °C, light breeze
- **Total cost:** ₹10,880 of ₹14,000 budget (₹3,120 left over)

## ✈️ Getting there & back
- **Go:** RedBus ordinary semi‑deluxe bus — Chennai (MGR Bus Stand) → Puducherry (MGR Bus Stand), ₹350 pp, dep 7:30 AM, arr 12:00 PM
- **Return:** Same operator, dep 5:30 PM, arr 10:00 PM
- **Why this option:** Cheapest comfortable choice; no airport hassle and drops you at the city centre, saving extra local transport.

## 🏨 Where to stay
1. **RMA Joliday Inn** — ₹1,200 /night · 3★ · free Wi‑Fi, breakfast included · book on Booking.com  
2. **Citynest Residency** — ₹1,300 /night · 3★ · rooftop cafe, free Wi‑Fi · book on MakeMyTrip  
3. **Lumina Auro Resort** — ₹1,150 /night · 3★ · garden view, complimentary breakfast · book on OYO  

## 🗓️ Day‑by‑day plan
### Day 1 — Fri, 27 Nov · Arrival & French Quarter stroll
- **7:30 AM** — Board RedBus semi‑deluxe bus from Chennai MGR Bus Stand  
- **12:00 PM** — Arrive Puducherry, drop at bus stand, take auto‑rickshaw (₹80) to **RMA Joliday Inn**, check‑in, freshen up  
- **1:00 PM** — Lunch at **New Banana Café** — Veg French toast, ₹250 pp  
- **2:30 PM** — Walk to **French Quarter** (0.5 km, 5 min) – admire colonial villas, pastel façades, and street art (free)  
- **4:00 PM** — Coffee break at **Café Des Arts** — Espresso & croissant, ₹180 pp  
- **5:30 PM** — Stroll along **Promenade Beach** (1 km, 15 min) – sunset view, street performers (free)  
- **7:30 PM** — Dinner at **Surguru Spot** — Masala dosa & coconut chutney, ₹220 pp  
- **9:00 PM** — Return to hotel, relax  

💡 *Tip:* Carry a small bottle of water; auto‑rickshaws accept cash only.

### Day 2 — Sat, 28 Nov · Beaches, cafés & heritage
- **8:00 AM** — Breakfast at hotel (included)  
- **9:00 AM** – Auto‑rickshaw to **Aurobindo Ashram** (2 km, 10 min) – entry free, quiet meditation spot  
- **10:30 AM** – Head to **Paradise Beach** (boat from Chunnambar, ₹300 pp round‑trip, 30 min) – swim & relax (free beach)  
- **1:00 PM** – Lunch at **Famous Masala & Pani Puri Chaat Centre** – Pani puri & samosa, ₹150 pp  
- **2:30 PM** – Return by boat, then auto to **Baker Street Café** (French Quarter) – try the **Macaron** platter, ₹200 pp  
- **4:00 PM** – Visit **Pondicherry Museum** (1 km, 5 min walk) – entry ₹30 pp  
- **6:00 PM** – Evening walk on **Rock Beach** (free) – great for photos at golden hour  
- **7:30 PM** – Dinner at **Coromandel Café** — Pasta alla Puttanesca, ₹350 pp  
- **9:30 PM** – Back to hotel, optional nightcap at hotel bar (₹120 pp)  

💡 *Tip:* Boat schedule runs every hour; buy tickets early to avoid queues.

### Day 3 — Sun, 29 Nov · Market & Return
- **8:00 AM** — Breakfast at hotel (included)  
- **9:00 AM** — Walk to **Sunday Market** (near Bharati Park, 1 km, 12 min) – browse handicrafts, souvenirs (budget ₹300)  
- **11:00 AM** — Light snack at **Surguru Spot** – Idli & sambar, ₹120 pp  
- **12:00 PM** — Check‑out, store luggage at hotel reception  
- **12:30 PM** – Lunch at **Le Café** (French Quarter) — Chicken Caesar salad, ₹300 pp  
- **2:00 PM** – Auto‑rickshaw back to bus stand, collect luggage  
- **5:30 PM** — Board return bus to Chennai  
- **10:00 PM** — Arrive Chennai, end of trip  

💡 *Tip:* Keep your bus ticket handy for quick boarding; the last bus departs at 5:30 PM.

## 🍽️ Food to try
- **Veg French Toast** – New Banana Café — ₹250 pp  
- **Masala Dosa** – Surguru Spot — ₹220 pp  
- **Macarons** – Baker Street Café — ₹200 pp  
- **Pani Puri** – Famous Masala & Pani Puri — ₹150 pp  
- **Pasta alla Puttanesca** – Coromandel Café — ₹350 pp  

## 💰 Budget breakdown
| Item | Cost |
|---|---|
| Transport (bus round‑trip) | ₹1,400 |
| Stay (2 nights) | ₹2,400 |
| Food (3 days × 2 people) | ₹4,800 |
| Local travel (autos, boat) | ₹1,200 |
| Activities & entry fees | ₹260 |
| Buffer | ₹820 |
| **Total** | **₹10,880** |

## 🎒 Weather & packing
- Light cotton shirts, shorts & a pair of jeans for evenings  
- Sunscreen, sunglasses, and a hat for beach time  
- Light sweater for breezy evenings on the promenade  

## 🏧 Useful nearby
- **ATM:** State Bank of India — Near MGR Bus Stand  
- **Petrol:** Indian Oil Pump — 2 km from hotel (on NH‑45A)  
- **Hospital:** Jawaharlal Institute of Post‑Graduate Medical Education & Research (JIPMER) — 3 km, +91‑44‑2227 8000  
- **Bus stand:** MGR Bus Stand (Puducherry) — main hub for city & intercity buses  

## 💡 Local tips
- Book the semi‑deluxe bus a day early on RedBus for the best price.  
- Carry small change for auto‑rickshaws; they rarely have change for large notes.  
- Beach entry is free, but parking fees (₹30 pp) apply if you drive.  
- Sunday market is cash‑only; negotiate for a better price on souvenirs.  
- No special permits needed for the listed attractions in November.
